#   drafts a reasoned budget-increase request instead of silently failing.

#   front door; week-one is report-only and it refuses auto-merge unless a human asks.
# coupling. Passes SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE). Skill is at repo root <name>/SKILL.md
# (not under skills/), so relPath is just the folder name.
# ported as methodology-only. Upstream uses mcp__codex__codex, $ARGUMENTS, Bash(*),
# research-wiki, GPU pilots — all Claude-Code-specific. Ports strip those deps, keeping
# the core research methodology (landscape survey, idea generation, novelty check).
# All 3 ports pass SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE) and skills-ref validate.
# All pass SkillSpector (17 LOW/SAFE, 7 MEDIUM/CAUTION, 0 blocked).
# test-driven-development is SKIPPED (duplicate of obra/superpowers one already installed).
# constraint-driven-development: added 2026-09-13. New upstream skill that writes a
# project's quality bar into CONSTRAINTS.md and then watches the diff for a weakened bar
# (@ts-ignore / eslint-disable, skipped or deleted tests, assertions stripped, stubs,
# thresholds edited down). It is the enforcement counterpart to the prose guidance in
# already in this bundle. Ships references/floor-guard.md alongside SKILL.md.
# All pass SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE). Includes create-design-md (not in README's
# original 6, but it's in the repo and passes scan).
# --- ECC skills (evan-ai/ECC): 35 universal skills from agent harness OS ---
# All pass SkillSpector (LOW/SAFE). Curated from 278 ECC skills — framework-specific,
# ECC-internal, and domain-niche skills excluded. Fork mirror: ~/dev/forks/JZKK720/ECC/
# --- ECC upstream new-skills triage (8 skills appeared 2026-08-16..09-12) ---
# Evaluated by running skillspector scan --no-llm on each. Two pass and are in
# scope (framework-agnostic agent-safety), two pass but are OUT of scope by this
# bundle's own curation rule ("framework-agnostic only; framework-specific,
# ECC-internal, and domain-niche excluded"), and two are blocked by the gate.
#   counterparty-channel-discipline - mention gating, silent observation and a
#     communication autonomy policy for agents in shared channels with external
#     counterparties. Prevents leaking internal context to outsiders.
#   operator-approval-loop - hashed drafts, epoch-keyed approvals, durable
#     delivery receipts and a pre-draft baseline gate for agent-drafted outbound
#     messages. Human operator approves/rejects/steers each send.
# PASSED THE GATE BUT OUT OF SCOPE - deliberately not installed:

#                                no other Rails entry in this manifest; installing one

#                                so it would ship as an entry point to nothing.
#   master-agreement-generator - legal drafting (counterparty master agreements from a
#   esign-field-placement      - e-signature envelope field placement via browser
# BLOCKED BY SKILLSPECTOR - parked as comments so the gate result stays visible:
#   taste-application   CRITICAL SC4 vulnerable deps (numpy, Pillow, setuptools x10 advisories)
#                       + HIGH AR2 anti-refusal statement + HIGH E2 env var harvesting
#                       + HIGH OH1 unvalidated output injection. Ships 61 script files.
#   taste-distillation  CRITICAL + MEDIUM AST4 subprocess calls + MEDIUM AST3 dynamic import.
# open-code-review: deterministic + agent hybrid code review via `ocr` CLI.
# open-code-review-delegate: delegation mode — host agent drives review, OCR
# handles file selection + rule resolution only (no OCR-side LLM needed).
# Both pass SkillSpector (pure markdown prompts, no bundled scripts).
# These are LOCAL ported copies (source: this repo's upstream/open-code-review/),
# deliberately NOT installed from alibaba/open-code-review. Verified 2026-09-13:
# upstream ships its own skills/open-code-review/SKILL.md at a different sha than the
# port, so a direct install would silently replace the Copilot-tuned wording. The
# ocr CLI itself is installed from upstream separately (see CLIs table).
# Note: ~/dev/forks/JZKK720/open-code-review/ is a plain 2-file copy, not a git
# checkout, so sync-fork-upstreams.ps1 correctly SKIPs it as "not a git checkout".
# --- impeccable ports (pbakaus/impeccable, Apache-2.0): 6 pure-prose design methodology skills ---
# Ported 2026-07-28. Upstream is a full application (CLI + browser extension + live server + hooks).
# These ports extract only the reference prose docs as standalone methodology skills.
# All 6 pass SkillSpector (5x 0/100 SAFE, 1x 7/100 SAFE) and skills-ref validate.
# Copilot is a documented first-class target; zero $ARGUMENTS/mcp__ coupling in skill bodies.
# 32 skills total; we cherry-pick the planning/execution/compounding/debug/git/autonomous skills.
# SKIP ce-code-review and ce-resolve-pr-feedback — they duplicate existing bundle review skills
# SKIP ce-proof (needs Every's hosted API), ce-test-xcode (needs XcodeBuildMCP), ce-riffrec (needs Riffrec).
# SKIP ce-polish, ce-dogfood (manual-only, browser-based, not model-invoked).
# The 9 entries below are advertised by upstream EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin but
# every one of them fails the SkillSpector hard gate (exit 1, do_not_install). Leaving them
# in the manifest made install-missing-skills.ps1 retry and re-block them on every run,
# reporting "BLOCKED" 9 times with no path to a different outcome. They are parked here as
# comments instead so the gate result stays visible without being re-attempted.
# See the blocked-skills table in README.md for the per-skill reason code.
#   ce-compound      HIGH E4 context leakage + HIGH RA1 self-modification
#   ce-optimize      HIGH TM1 - tool parameter abuse
#   ce-babysit-pr    HIGH YR1 - YARA destructive autonomous actions
# Zero Claude-Code coupling; Copilot explicitly supported. Each ships stdlib-only
# Python scripts with CI-eval-gated tests. Apache-2.0.
# SKIP self-improving-agent-skills (standalone FastAPI+Next.js web app, not a drop-in skill).
# SKIP advisor-orchestrator-worker, thinking-out-loud (lighter value, can add later).

# Turns plain-English system descriptions or codebases into self-contained HTML
# diagrams (architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle). Zero-dep
# renderer, typed JSON IR, validation, PNG/SVG/WebM export. Supports Claude
# NOTE: this entry currently FAILS at install with a HIGH YARA hit
# The correct SkillRelPath is archify/archify, which was missing here.
# --- book-to-skill (virgiliojr94, MIT): convert books into agent skills ---
# Converts PDF/EPUB/DOCX/HTML/Markdown/RTF/MOBI into structured agent skills
# (frameworks, mental models, decision rules, anti-patterns). Generates per-
# chapter files loaded on-demand. Upstream blocked by SkillSpector (CRITICAL,
# 100/100 - bundled Python scripts with subprocess/dynamic imports). Clean
# methodology-only port uses the bundle's `markitdown` for extraction.
# Chinese/English design skill for prototypes, slides, animations, infographics,

# Clean methodology-only port retains the full prose; assets referenced from
